text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Oh...? Where am I...?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
How strange...?
Could I have taken the wrong path?
choice_data_list: We ended up somewhere weird, huh...?
We ended up somewhere weird, didn't we...?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Yes—it feels somewhat like a lonely place.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my...?
The person over there, could it be—

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Wh-Wh-What should we do, Kiseki~!?
Boo is scared of ghosts~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
L-L-Let's calm down!
If this really is that haunted spot,
we gotta figure out how to escape calmly~...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Umâ

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Gyaaaaa!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"According to them, the two of them got lost as well.
And apparently, this place is rumored to be
a haunted spot around the academy...!?"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Walking through the back alleys,
a ruined shrine suddenly appears!
Step inside, and...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I heard that from behind the shrine, a super-terrifying ghost appears...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And while we were talking about that,
from behind the shrine...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clatter! Rattle, rattle, clatter...!)

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Whaaahaaa--!!
Noooo! Don't eat meeeee--!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"I-I'll be fine! If worst comes to worst,
I'll just bust out that 'Rin-Pyo-Toh-Sha~' chant
I learned from "Uma-Gama-Ga!""

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I mean...
If ghosts really do exist, I kinda wanna see one myself~, just saying...!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek?! But, but!
I don't want anything bad to happen to Kiseki!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The two of them make a big fuss...
Still, that doesn't necessarily mean it's a ghost.
Even if it were, though...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Then I'll go check it out!
Come forth, Spirit-Slaying Blade! *Schwing!*

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Please rest assured.
No matter what comes out,
I won't just slice it down out of nowhere."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
“Still... there's that famous saying,
‘Without strength, you can't protect anything!’, right?”

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Ohh! As expected of Kiseki!
You're so dependable!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
UmâKiseki-san.
Could you wait a momentâ?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Maybe the ghost... is scared too...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
choice_data_list: Yeah... We're the ones who came out of nowhere...
Yeah... We're the ones who came out of nowhere...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Yes—you are completely right.
And yet, I caused such a commotion...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: I might... have surprised you.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Ngh...! Y-You're totally right!
The ghost hasn't even done anything yet, but Boo and the others are...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
The protagonist's side was actually the villain trope?!
Urgh! That's no good...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
No—
I understand how both of you feel as well.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
It's not as if I'm not scared, either.
I can understand both the feeling of curiosity...
and the feeling of caution.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Still—first off,
why don't we try having a chat?
With the ghost...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Curren Bouquetd'or and I gently called
out toward the back of the shrine.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Umâis someone there?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
If you are hesitant... to come out,
would you at least... talk to me?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Then, from behind the shrine,
came a rustling sound...
and a little brown thing waddled out.

text_block_list.name: Tanuki
text_block_list.text:
Shaaaa!
Squeeeeeeak~~!!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Oh my... a tanuki...

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
S-So cute...!
Sorry about that, didn't mean to scare ya.
Boo and the gang aren't scary at all!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Waaah, I'm sorry too!
Man, turns out it was just a false alarm after all... talk about an anticlimax.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
There, there...
That was scary, wasn't it? You're safe now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems the matter is settled.
It felt like it was all thanks to Curren Bouquetd'or,
who took everyone's feelings to heart.
choice_data_list: It's all thanks to Bouquet's kindness!
It's all thanks to Bouquet's kindness!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems the matter is settled.
It felt like it was all thanks to Curren Bouquetd'or,
who took everyone's feelings to heart.
choice_data_list: It's all thanks to Bouquet's kindness!
It's all thanks to Bouquet's kindness!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"No, that goes for you too, Trainer-san!
I'll follow the kind example you two set!
Because I believe that's what true strength really is!"
choice_data_list: Huh! I couldn't really say it properly, and...
Huh! I couldn't really say it properly, and...

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
But you felt the same way, didn't you?
Both of them are super kind!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Oh no...
To call me kind, that's just...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: No, I didn't do anything.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I'm just glad...
that no one got hurt.
